name: Future Forms
description: Will, be going to, present forms with future meaning, Future Continuous and Future Perfect, and future time clauses.

questions.title: Look at those clouds. It ___ any minute now.
questions.explanation: Хмари — очевидний доказ, тому вживають «be going to», а не «will».

questions.title: The phone is ringing. Don't get up, I ___ it.
questions.explanation: Рішення ухвалене в момент мовлення — це «will».

questions.title: We ___ dinner with the Petrenkos on Saturday. The table is already booked.
questions.explanation: Столик уже замовлено, тобто це домовленість — Present Continuous.

questions.title: The museum ___ at nine o'clock every day, including Sunday.
questions.explanation: Розклад роботи музею передають Present Simple.

questions.title: Which form expresses a decision made at the moment of speaking?
questions.explanation: Спонтанне рішення в момент мовлення виражають через «will».

questions.title: I have already decided. I ___ apply to a technical university.
questions.explanation: Рішення ухвалене раніше — це намір, тому «be going to».

questions.title: Which sentence about future time is correct?
options: I will call you when I arrive.
I will call you when I will arrive.
I call you when I will arrive.
I am calling you when I will arrive.
questions.explanation: Після «when» майбутній час не вживають — потрібен Present Simple.

questions.title: Do you think prices ___ next year?
questions.explanation: Питання про думку щодо майбутнього — «will».

questions.title: Our flight ___ at 6.40 tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: Розклад рейсу передають Present Simple.

questions.title: Which sentence offers help?
options: Shall I carry that bag for you?
Do I carry that bag for you?
Am I carrying that bag for you?
Will I carrying that bag for you?
questions.explanation: «Shall I …?» — усталена форма пропозиції допомоги.

questions.title: She ___ twenty next month.
questions.explanation: Простий факт про майбутнє передають через «will».

questions.title: Which word signals a future time clause where 'will' is not used?
questions.explanation: Після «as soon as» уживають теперішній час замість майбутнього.

questions.title: There is no bread left. I ___ some on my way home.
questions.explanation: Рішення ухвалене щойно, у момент мовлення, — «will».

questions.title: What does 'be about to' express?
options: something that will happen in the very near future
questions.explanation: «Be about to» означає дію, яка відбудеться за мить.

questions.title: Match each future form with the sentence that illustrates it.
pairs: That looks heavy. I will help you.
be going to for an intention
I am going to study medicine.
I am meeting the dentist at four.
questions.explanation: Кожна форма майбутнього має своє типове вживання.

questions.title: Match each situation with the most natural future form.
pairs: making a prediction based on evidence
questions.explanation: Вибір форми залежить від того, що саме мовець виражає: доказ, обіцянку, розклад чи домовленість.

questions.title: Match each sentence beginning with the ending that completes it.
pairs: I will text you as soon as
We are going to move house
questions.explanation: Форма в другій частині залежить від сполучника й типу майбутнього.

questions.title: Match each future expression with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Ці конструкції різняться мірою певності та плановості.

questions.title: This time next week I ___ on a beach in Odesa.
questions.explanation: «This time next week» указує на дію в процесі в майбутньому — Future Continuous.

questions.title: By the end of the course you ___ over two hundred new words.
questions.explanation: «By the end» указує на завершення до моменту — Future Perfect.

questions.title: Which sentence describes an action that will be in progress at a future moment?
options: At eight tomorrow we will be driving to Kyiv.
At eight tomorrow we will drive to Kyiv.
At eight tomorrow we will have driven to Kyiv.
At eight tomorrow we drive to Kyiv.
questions.explanation: Дія триватиме в конкретний момент майбутнього — Future Continuous.

questions.title: Don't call me at seven. I ___ my exam then.
questions.explanation: О сьомій іспит триватиме, тому Future Continuous.

questions.title: By 2030 the company ___ in business for half a century.
questions.explanation: «By 2030 … for half a century» — тривалість до моменту в майбутньому.

questions.title: Which sentence is the most polite way of asking about somebody's plans?
options: Will you be using the printer this afternoon?
Are you going to use the printer this afternoon?
Do you use the printer this afternoon?
Will you use the printer this afternoon?
questions.explanation: Future Continuous у питанні звучить найввічливіше: він не тисне на співрозмовника.

questions.title: He ___ the report by Friday, so we can discuss it at the weekend.
questions.explanation: «By Friday» указує на завершення до вказаного часу — Future Perfect.

questions.title: Which future time clause contains a mistake?
options: I will tell her when I will see her.
I will tell her when I see her.
I will tell her after I have seen her.
I will tell her the moment I see her.
questions.explanation: Після «when» у підрядному часу «will» не вживають.

questions.title: The negotiations ___ to continue until late in the evening.
questions.explanation: Пасивна конструкція «are expected to» передає очікування без указівки на джерело.

questions.title: What is the difference between 'I will see him' and 'I will be seeing him'?
options: The second suggests a meeting that will happen in the normal course of events.
The second is more urgent than the first.
The second refers to a shorter action.
There is no difference in meaning.
questions.explanation: «Will be seeing» означає зустріч, яка станеться природним чином, без спеціального наміру.

questions.title: We had better hurry, or we ___ the last bus.
questions.explanation: Ідеться про ймовірний наслідок, тому «will».

questions.title: By the time you read this letter, I ___ the country.
questions.explanation: Дія завершиться до моменту читання — Future Perfect.

questions.title: I doubt whether the parcel ___ before the weekend.
questions.explanation: Після «I doubt whether» уживають «will» для майбутнього.

questions.title: Match each future form with the exact meaning it carries.
pairs: I will be working at nine.
I will have worked eight hours by then.
I will have been working since dawn.
questions.explanation: Кожна форма майбутнього передає свій відтінок: процес, завершення, тривалість чи простий факт.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the speaker's intention.
pairs: I promise I will pay you back.
I am going to complain to the manager.
Will you close the window, please?
questions.explanation: Форма майбутнього часто виражає не час, а намір мовця.

questions.title: Match each time linker with the tense that follows it in a future sentence.
pairs: present simple with a precautionary meaning
questions.explanation: Кожен сполучник вимагає свого часу в підрядній частині.

questions.title: Match each prediction with the evidence type behind it.
pairs: She will probably enjoy the film.
The forecast says it will freeze.
Interest rates are set to rise.
questions.explanation: Форма передбачення залежить від того, на чому воно ґрунтується.

questions.title: Match each faulty future sentence with the reason it is wrong.
pairs: I will go shopping when I will finish work.
will is not used in a time clause
evidence calls for be going to
The train will leave at 9.05 every day.
a timetable needs the present simple
I am going to help you with that suitcase.
a spontaneous offer calls for will
questions.explanation: Кожна помилка має свою причину: «will» у підрядному часу, доказ замість думки, розклад, спонтанність.

questions.title: Should the funding be approved, construction ___ next autumn.
questions.explanation: Це формальна умовна конструкція з інверсією; головна частина стоїть у «will».

questions.title: Which sentence is the most formal way of announcing a scheduled event?
options: The ceremony is to take place on 12 May.
The ceremony is taking place maybe on 12 May.
The ceremony will be taken place on 12 May.
The ceremony is going to happen on 12 May.
questions.explanation: «Is to take place» — офіційна форма оголошення про заплановану подію.

questions.title: Delegates ___ to register before the opening session.
questions.explanation: «Are required to» — формальна пасивна конструкція вимоги.

questions.title: Which sentence expresses an unavoidable future consequence?
options: Such a policy is bound to provoke criticism.
Such a policy is likely provoking criticism.
Such a policy will be provoked criticism.
Such a policy provokes criticism tomorrow.
questions.explanation: «Be bound to» означає неминучий наслідок.

questions.title: On no account ___ the building before the alarm is switched off.
questions.explanation: Після «on no account» на початку речення відбувається інверсія.

questions.title: Which sentence correctly uses the future perfect continuous?
options: By June she will have been teaching here for thirty years.
By June she will have taught here since thirty years.
By June she will be teaching here for thirty years already.
By June she is teaching here for thirty years.
questions.explanation: Future Perfect Continuous показує тривалість до моменту в майбутньому.

questions.title: Match each formal future structure with its meaning.
pairs: The minister is to visit the region.
The train is due to arrive at noon.
The reform is set to take effect in July.
questions.explanation: Формальні конструкції різняться відтінком: домовленість, розклад, план, очікування.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the degree of certainty it expresses.
questions.explanation: Модальні слова точно градуюють міру певності мовця.

questions.title: Match each future structure with the register in which it is typical.
pairs: We are to convene at ten.
We will be convening at ten.
questions.explanation: Форми майбутнього різняться регістром: be to — офіційне оголошення, will be doing — нейтральний діловий стиль, Present Continuous — розмовна домовленість.
